projects.title: Realmbreakgame
bullets: Developed a fantasy game in C# with custom ShaderLab and HLSL shaders, sustaining 92 active development days.
Cut several planned mechanics after solo playtesting showed they confused rather than improved the experience.

projects.title: Cat Breed Guesser
bullets: Built a Python and JavaScript web app that classifies cat breeds from user-submitted photos.
Simplified the upload flow after early testers were unsure what input the tool expected.

projects.title: Calorie Clash
bullets: Built a JavaScript and CSS web app for comparing meal choices during a weekend build session.
Rewrote onboarding copy after a tester misunderstood the app's comparison feature on first use.

leadership.title: Playtest Coordinator
bullets: Ran playtests for five student teams, translating vague player feedback into specific scope decisions before deadline.
Noticed teams cut features late and introduced a pre-jam scope checklist adopted the following semester.
